newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Far East says deposits to boost growth.
newsitem.headline: Far East says deposits to boost growth.

text.p: Far East Bank and Trust Co (FEBTC) is expanding its depositor base to fuel income growth in the coming years, FEBTC president Octavio Espiritu said on Monday.

"We are putting out a lot of new deposit services which are all technology-based ... It will allow us to deliver any and all forms of deposit services," Espiritu told Reuters before the bank's stockholders' meeting.
The bank's deposit liabilities grew by 25.6 percent to 78.7 bilion pesos last year from 62.6 billion pesos registered the previous year.

The bank was also on the lookout for cheaper sources of funds in light of the declining domestic interest rates, although it just issued $160 million worth of floating rate certificates of deposit and offered a stock rights last year, Espiritu said.
Espiritu said he expected local interest rates, with the 91-day benchmark rate falling to single-digits last week, to remain low throughout the year.
"It's now up to the banks to improve the volume of its operation and improve other income sources," he said.
The bank's loan portfolio rose 39.9 percent to 73.1 billion pesos last year from 52.2 billion in 1995.
The bank was able to maintain its lead in the trust business with assets reaching 48.8 billion pesos by the end of last year, he said.
The bank reported a 29.42 percent growth in its net income last year to reach 2.26 billion pesos from 1.76 billion the previous year.
"Our income will grow handsomely this year," Espiritu said, but declined to give specific numbers.
